# Finding codes

Every finding carries a stable `code`; match on it in scripts and CI. Messages may change.
Severities: `error` (exit 2 from `validate`/`export`), `warning` (exit 2 with `--strict`), `suggestion`, `info` (shown with `-v`). Some codes are downgraded in context (e.g. `CONT005` is `info` between preparation stages).

<!-- generated by scripts/gen_findings_doc.py; tests/test_docs.py keeps it in sync -->

## Continuity

| Code | Default severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `CONT000` | info | Healthy hand-off between chained steps |
| `CONT001` | error | Time gap between a step and the step it continues from |
| `CONT002` | warning | Restart without a resolvable producer, or time reset mid-chain |
| `CONT003` | warning | Step overlaps the step it continues from |
| `CONT004` | info | Continuity not measured (times unavailable) |
| `CONT005` | warning | Step continues the previous state but restarts the clock |

## Sequences

| Code | Default severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `SEQ001` | error | Numbered run family is missing members |
| `SEQ002` | error | Numbered run family has duplicate members |

## Completeness

| Code | Default severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `CMP001` | warning | Step writes trajectory frames but no trajectory file was found |
| `CMP002` | warning | Engine log is incomplete (run did not finish) |
| `CMP003` | warning | Trajectory frame count disagrees with the log |
| `CMP004` | warning | Trajectory time span disagrees with the log |

## Consistency

| Code | Default severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `CONS001` | warning | Production steps disagree on a parameter |
| `CONS002` | warning | Frame interval from control file disagrees with trajectory |
| `CONS003` | warning | Production steps disagree on engine or version |
| `CONS004` | error | Atom counts disagree between files |
